title: 第2000章 各自存疑究竟是什么来头第1999章 真正目的
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: 嗯？
林羽手中动作一顿。
对方的话令他心生无穷波澜。
好歹他是泰山崩于前而不动声色之人。
要不然，被九极道钟器灵这一刺激，恐怕手中禁法都得瓦解掉。
稳住手中法之后，趁着雪天后正在心神放入空灵之际，林羽迅速将其植入雪天后的体内。
看到事情完成，雪天后并无异样，这才放心不少。
这时。
林羽脸色前所未有的凝重，暗中质问
“小九，你怎么会认识这种禁法？”
“额！本……本灵胡乱猜的。”
林羽意味深长追问
“胡猜是吗？那阴阳无极这个名号呢？你……也是猜的吗？”
“额……这……这个，咳咳！其实……本灵也不知道为啥，说出来你可能不信，本灵意识就自然而然的浮现这个名字。”
林羽目光阴厉，沉声道
“是吗？小九，你真的只是九极道钟的器灵吗？”
“咳咳！当然，本灵天天待在九极道钟里面，不是器灵还能是什么，你说是不是这个理？”
听着发虚之声。
林羽眸光闪烁不定。
他早就怀疑这家伙不对劲。
昔日。
林阆天极尽升华，与大道真火融为一体，曾有留言，让自己勿信任此宝。
如今看来，这家伙果然是存在问题。
阴阳无极这个名字，不该是区区一个器灵能知悉的。
现今这情况，那就只有一个解释。
那就是炼无极！
炼无极真实身份，乃是从阴阳无极分化而出——先天阴炁之灵。
因此。
只有炼无极才知道阴阳无极这个名号。
现在这个器灵不仅知晓这个名号。
还知晓自己所使的禁忌法——阴虚阳实之术。
此术亦是传自【先天无极阴阳法】。
此道经禁忌法共有上下篇。
content_en:
Um?
Lin Yu moved his hands.
The other party's words made him feel endless waves.
After all, he is a person who remains calm despite the collapse of Mount Tai.
Otherwise, if stimulated by the spirit of Jiuji Dao Bell, I am afraid that all the forbidden techniques in his hand will be destroyed.
After stabilizing his technique, Lin Yu quickly implanted it into Xue Tianhou's body while her mind was in the ethereal state.
Seeing that the matter was completed and there was nothing unusual about the Snow Queen, I felt relieved.
At this time.
Lin Yu's face was more solemn than ever before, and he secretly asked
"Xiaojiu, how do you know this forbidden method?"
"Uh! I...I just made a random guess."
Lin Yu asked meaningfully
"Are you guessing? What about the name Yin Yang Wuji? Did you... also guess?"
"Uh... this... this, cough! Actually... I don't know why. You may not believe it when I tell you, but this name naturally appears in my consciousness."
Lin Yu's eyes were stern and he said in a deep voice.
"Really? Xiaojiu, are you really just the weapon spirit of Jiuji Dao Zhong?"
"Ahem! Of course, this spirit stays in the Jiuji Dao Bell every day. What else can it be if it is not a weapon spirit? Do you think this is the truth?"
Listen to the sound of weakness.
Lin Yu's eyes flickered uncertainly.
He had long suspected that something was wrong with this guy.
The old days.
Lin Langtian was extremely sublimated and merged with the true fire of the avenue. He once left a message telling himself not to trust this treasure.
Now it seems that this guy really has a problem.
The name Yin Yang Wuji should not be known by just a weapon spirit.
There is only one explanation for the current situation.
That is Lian Wuji!
Lian Wuji's true identity is derived from the differentiation of Yin and Yang Wuji - the innate Yin Qi spirit.
therefore.
Only Lian Wuji knows the name Yin Yang Wuji.
Now this weapon spirit not only knows this name.
He also knew the taboo method he used - the technique of deficiency of yin and excess of yang.
This technique is also inherited from [Innate Infinite Yin and Yang Method].
This Taoist scripture contains two chapters.
